description: Buggy the Star Clown is the nominal president of Cross Guild, and one of the current Four Emperors dominating the New World.[3][2][16] Initially a Roger Pirates apprentice alongside Shanks,[8] Buggy succeeded his disbanded mentors as a career pirate in the East Blue, in time becoming captain of the Buggy Pirates. One of the earliest enemies defeated by Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates,[4] revenge drove him to an alliance with "Iron Mace" Alvida and pursuit into the Grand Line.[6...
